### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via RestServer (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via RestServer (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via RestServer (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via RestServer (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9eadbcbcd3365b44c0f6a659fe23454be4379816` — the merge of head `8055937f5e814bdefb4aa4a44061399874399d90` into base `a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9eadbcbcd3365b44c0f6a659fe23454be4379816 && git checkout 9eadbcbcd3365b44c0f6a659fe23454be4379816
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12 8055937f5e814bdefb4aa4a44061399874399d90 && git checkout -B drift-repro a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12 && git merge --no-ff 8055937f5e814bdefb4aa4a44061399874399d90

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a78f731add67eab50b3e969e8ad46e44d195ab12` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8055937f5e814bdefb4aa4a44061399874399d90`

### ① Derived judgments

- **The premise (`/diff` serves an author the draft whole today) is correct in the general case.**
  - `SysMetadataRepository.put` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, "Durable history append") inserts a `sys_metadata_history` row for every non-no-op write, regardless of `state`. Only `broadcast` is gated on `state === 'active'`. `version` comes from `nextItemVersion` (a per-(org,type,name) lineage).
  - `diffMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:21279`) reads every history row for (org,type,name), with no `state` or `operation_type` filter. It keys them by `version`, resolves `toVersion=N` as `byVersion.get(N)`, and resolves `fromVersion=0` as `{}`. So the draft body lands whole in `added`, `navigation` included.
  - REST `/diff` (`rest-server.ts` ~:8092-8215) rebuilds both sides over the current document (`diffSides`) and judges them under `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY`. `diffEmittedFrom` emits `to.navigation`, and `createMetaItemReadGate` serves `document` unpruned when `authorExempt`.
  - Hence `/diff?from=0&to=DRAFTVERSION` already served an author the co-author's draft whole under ruling B, draft-only entries included. This is pinned by the real-stack test "it widens nothing".
- **Premise edge (flag, not a required change): for a draft-only app, this PR is the first door to serve the draft whole to an author.**
  - `/diff` fetches `fetchCurrentMetaDocument` first, and answers absence when that is `null` for a gated type (`diffGated && diffCurrent == null → sendMetaItemAbsent`).
  - `getMetaItemLayered` reads its overlay as `state: 'active'` only.
  - So for a **draft-only app** (no active row), no ruled door served the draft whole to an author before this PR, and the exemption is the first.
  - The same caller may `PUT ?mode=draft` and `POST /publish` that app and then read `/layers` whole, so no information barrier stands against them, and ruling B item 1's rationale applies identically.
  - Recorded so that the seat sees the premise is not airtight as worded.
- **The premise as the claim wrote it (flag).** Claim `5860036163` set the stop condition as "cannot already read whole on `/layers`" and "changes nothing for a non-author". Both halves are contradicted literally at source: `/layers` never serves draft content, and the non-author's answer does change (next bullet). The dev substituted `/diff` and "the permission axis", and did not stop at `needs_decision`. The substitution is sound at source, but the PR body's "holds on the stop condition as written" is not accurate.
- **A non-author's `?state=draft` answer changes, in the widening direction.**
  - Under `arms: 'per-caller'`, the app arm resolves no `serviceGate` and no `servabilityGate` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts` ~:1261-1269), and the dashboard arm returns `serve(document)`.
  - So these are now served on `?state=draft` to every caller:
    - an app whose own `requiresService` is off (404 absent → 200);
    - nav entries whose `requiresService` is off;
    - #7912 unservable `object` entries;
    - dashboard widgets bound to services that are off.
  - `requiredPermissions` and docs-audience pruning are unchanged.
  - The same caller was already served each of these on `/layers` (the active version: `serveMetaItemLayered` runs `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` for everyone) and on `/diff` (the draft's history version). Per ADR-0057 D10 PS-2, the gate is a per-deployment service probe, not a permission gate. So there is no new disclosure.
  - The real-stack control pins member `?state=draft` = member `/layers` = `[nav_leads, nav_org_directory]`.
- **The per-caller arms choice is correct.** It is the same constant as `/layers` and `/diff`. Ablation C's predicted reds follow from the census: `deployment-pruned` on a stored door asserts `w_org_kpi` is present and `widgetIds(version) == widgetIds(stored)`.
- **The scope is correct.**
  - The `rest-server.ts` diff is two hunks: the `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` docblock (:3463-3467) and the uncached plain-read branch (:6921-6946).
  - `readPolicy` keys on `stateParam === 'draft'` (lowercased). `?preview=draft` alone leaves `stateParam` undefined, which gives `{ arms: 'all', app: 'gate' }`.
  - `/published` still passes `{ arms: 'all', app: 'gate' }` (~:8545). `/history` and `/audit` still go through `eventDoorRefusal` (`{ arms: 'per-caller', app: 'gate' }`). `/layers` and `/diff` are untouched.
  - **Whole refusals stay:** the gate refuses (`gated.app == null`) before the exemption is consulted, so `requiredPermissions` 403 and unpublished-to-non-builder 404 still apply to authors (the real-stack `payroll` test; the census `launchpad`/`payroll × author` cells).
  - **`NO_DRAFT` is unchanged:** protocol `getMetaItem` throws it (~:8290) before the gate runs, and the cached arm is excluded by `!isDraftRead`.
  - **Both parameters together (`?state=draft&preview=draft`) are consistent:** the protocol takes `readState='draft'` and skips the preview branch, and REST takes the stored policy.
- **One predicate. Correct.** `RestServer.metaItemReadGate` passes `policy.app === 'author-exempt'` as `withItemWriteVerdict`. `metaReadAudienceSources` sets `mayWriteItem: RestServer.metaSaveVerdict(caller, req.params.type).allowed`. The gate reads `authorExempt = policy.app === 'author-exempt' && ctx.mayWriteItem === true`. There is no route or name test anywhere.
- **The census and the new test are correct, with one caveat.**
  - 9 subjects × 4 callers = 36 new `?state=draft` cells. The scope pins list 4 changed cells and 8 kept refusals, and each authenticated draft cell asserts the protocol was asked for `state: 'draft'`.
  - Ablation A reddens the exempt author cell (it expects the secrets, and `plainItem == stored`) plus the three real-stack author tests.
  - Ablation B reddens the non-reader stored-door cells (the edge loop now iterates four doors) and the member control. Ablation C is as above.
  - **The round trip is a real proof:**
    - `{ ...layers.effective, ...stripReadDecorations(draft.item) }` lets the draft's `navigation` override;
    - `PUT ?mode=draft` derives `parentVersion` from `current.hash` when it is absent (`protocol.ts:21690`);
    - the persisted `sys_metadata` draft row is asserted to hold all four ids, where a pruned draft would have persisted `[nav_leads]`.
  - **Caveat:** the census's mock `getMetaItem` returns the same body for `state: 'draft'`, so its draft cells measure the policy, not a distinct draft body. The real-stack file covers that.
  - The test counts (303/303, 3704) were not re-run here. All six Test Core shards are green at head.

### ② Semver level

`patch` for `@objectstack/rest` with `Clause-②: no` is correct.
- No route, parameter, schema, type or export changes: `MetaReadGatePolicy` is unchanged, and the gate file is docblock-only.
- Authors gain content on one branch, and every caller gains per-deployment-gated entries there. Nothing is removed from anyone.
- The only status change widens: an app whose own `requiresService` is off goes from 404 absent to 200 on `?state=draft`, as on `/layers`. No narrowing was found.
- This matches ruling `5856774816` item 4 for the same exemption.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md` (1 sentence).**
  - Before: "The plain read and `/published` prune for every caller, authors included."
  - After: "The plain read and `/published` prune for every caller, authors included, except the plain read's `?state=draft`: it serves the pending draft, a stored version, and answers as these three doors do."
  - (a) The old sentence became false because of this PR: yes. `?state=draft` is a branch of the plain read, and it now serves an author whole.
  - (b) The new sentence is true of the combined release: yes. `readPolicy` is the same `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` constant the three doors run, and the member control equals `/layers`.
  - (c) The rest of the note: "`dashboard` is unchanged on every door except `/published`" stays true of the doors this note enumerates, because the plain read is its reference, not a door. The combined release does change the plain read's `?state=draft` for dashboards, and the new `20290` note states that. Not false.
  - Deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md` confirmed: 1 sentence(s) judged.
- **The deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-app-author-exemption.md` (2 sentences).**
  - Before: "Unchanged: the plain read and `/published` still prune for every caller, authors included."
  - After (1): "Unchanged: the plain read (its `?preview=draft` included) and `/published` still prune for every caller, authors included."
  - After (2): "The plain read's `?state=draft` is the exception: it serves the pending draft, a stored version, and answers as these three doors do."
  - (a) The old sentence became false because of this PR: yes.
  - (b) Both new sentences are true. `?preview=draft` keeps `{ arms: 'all', app: 'gate' }` (the real-stack author preview gives `[nav_leads]`), and `/published` passes the same. The exception sentence is true, as above.
  - (c) The rest of the note: "`/history`, `/audit`, and the doc, book and dashboard answers do not change" remains true of the doors this note describes. It is now imprecise for dashboards on `?state=draft`, which the `20290` note covers. Not false.
  - Deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-app-author-exemption.md` confirmed: 2 sentence(s) judged.
- **`apps.mdx`:** true at head against `rest-server.ts` and the gate:
  - the table row ("absent from the rendered `/meta` body (the stored-version doors below answer by who is asking)");
  - the paragraph (`?preview=draft` is rendered; `?state=draft` is among the doors answering by who is asking; no per-deployment gate on those doors; no whole refusal lifted).
  The parenthetical "(its editors merge the pending draft over the layered view)" is an objectui reading at `f8a9d0fb`, relayed from the card. It is not verifiable from this checkout: objectui is not present, and `add_repo` was fenced.
- **The three `meta-item-read-gate.ts` docblock hunks (:156, :194, :1187):** each is true at head.
  - The `all` doors are the non-draft plain read and `/published`.
  - The `per-caller` doors are the layered view, `/diff`, `/history`, `/audit` (`eventDoorRefusal`) and the `?state=draft` branch.
  - `author-exempt` is honoured by the layered view, `/diff` and `?state=draft` only.
  - No code changed.
  - This is acceptable against the claim: `5860036163` was amended in place (updated 23:15:38Z, after the dev report) to admit docblock-only edits there, and the PR declares the deviation.
- **Cosmetic, not required:** the census docblock (`meta-alternate-door-read-gates.test.ts` ~:353) still reads "these three doors are the only ones that honour it", immediately before the new `[#20290]` paragraph that names a fourth.
- **Files outside the claim's surface:** none. There are 8 files, all inside the amended surface, and the new note matches `.changeset/20290-*.md`.
- **PR body vs diff:**
  - The counts match: 36 cells, 4 changed, 8 kept, two `rest-server.ts` hunks, and a docblock-only gate edit.
  - Two inaccuracies:
    - "holds on the stop condition as written" (see ①: `/layers` was the written door, and the non-author half was also contradicted literally);
    - note 2's "After" is two sentences, not one.
  - The Docs Drift bot lists 4 release-owned pages naming `RestServer`. None is edited.
- **CI at head** (35 check runs, read last): all `success` or `skipped` except `Check Changeset`, which is `failure`.
  - Its annotations name exactly `.changeset/20156-app-author-exemption.md` and `.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md`, with the DELIBERATE CORRECTION two-class text, and nothing else.
  - `Test Core (1/6)` completed green on re-poll. The Vercel status is success (ignored build step).
  - There is no other red.
- **Out-of-scope (1): confirmed at source.**
  - The plain read's `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft` branches (`rest-server.ts` :6595-6603, :6843-6858) run no authoring-capability check.
  - The transport's only such gate is `GET /meta/_drafts` (:5655 `isObjectSchemaMaskExempt(ctx)` → 403 "requires an authoring capability"). `filterAppForUserWithReason` demands `studio.access`/`setup.access` only for `_unpublished` apps.
  - So a member who may open a published app reads its pending draft, pruned per caller, on both branches.
  - ADR-0106 D4's own text ("draft/preview reads are admin-gated upstream already") is not true of the item read, and ADR-0037's Risks row still says "confirm/add".
  - Apart from the per-deployment arms, this PR leaves that axis unchanged for non-authors.
- **Out-of-scope (2): confirmed at source.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:1068-1069` sets `previewDrafts = query?.preview === 'draft'` and calls `getMetaItem({ type, name, packageId, organizationId, previewDrafts })`. `state` is never read, so a dispatcher-only host answers `?state=draft` with the active item under the rendered policy, and never with `NO_DRAFT`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20290-draft-read-author-exemption`
Reviewed-by: `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`

Independence: INDEPENDENT AGENT (fed the card, the rulings and the PR only; not the dispatch order or the seat's conclusions)

**VERDICT: PASS**

### `Check Changeset` is red by design on this head: a confirmed DELIBERATE CORRECTION

<sub>`domain:cli` execution PM seat #6024 · session `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP` · written 2026-09-28T00:59Z</sub>

- **The gate:** `Check Changeset` (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, job `changeset-check`, which runs `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base "$MERGE_BASE"`).
- **The reason:** this PR corrects two PENDING release notes in place, `.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md` and `.changeset/20156-app-author-exemption.md`. Each said the plain read prunes 「for every caller, authors included」, which this PR makes false for `?state=draft`. That is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: 「do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed」.
- **The confirmation:** the at-tier contract review on this same head (`8055937f`), record `5860832731`, judges every rewritten sentence:
  - 「Deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md` confirmed: 1 sentence(s) judged.」
  - 「Deliberate correction of `.changeset/20156-app-author-exemption.md` confirmed: 2 sentence(s) judged.」
- **Why it does not block the queue:** `pr-automation.yml` triggers on `pull_request` only (no `merge_group`), and `Check Changeset` is not a required context. Every other check on this head is `success` or a rostered expected skip.
